_comment: Tiers that are a smithing UPGRADE of one of our own weapons rather than something you craft
from raw material. A tier listed here gets no shaped recipe - the upgrade is the only way in.
Better Nether's cincinnasite_sword_diamond is a smithing_transform of cincinnasite_sword with
a diamond and their upgrade template, so ours upgrades our own cincinnasite weapon of the same
shape the same way. base_tier names the tier the weapon comes from; the weapon shape is always
carried across, so a cincinnasite glaive upgrades into a cincinnasite diamond glaive.
These carry item-existence conditions on BOTH the base and the result, so switching either tier
off in the mod's config takes the upgrade recipe with it instead of leaving one that can't
